entries.cd5a9088ad9fc9f5: This is a single-segment business consisting of the company and 5 consolidated subsidiaries. Centered on the patented technology "Dancing Stone," the double-lock clasp "EXL-LOCK" that can be attached and detached easily with one hand, and the tennis chain, which the company has put into in-house mass production, it manufactures and sells domestic jewelry and accessory products and overseas parts, and holds exclusive domestic sales rights for hollow chains manufactured by a major Indonesian jewelry manufacturer. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥5,536 million, of which Japan accounted for ¥4,273 million, or 77.1% of the total by region. Manufacturing of products is outsourced to external factories, except for some items.
